positioning: $U is a unified liquidity layer — 'A United Layer of Money'. Position as infrastructure / liquidity layer, never as a coin.

typography.bodyRole: Document face — documents, decks, body copy (Extralight 200 to Bold 700 + italics)
typography.eyebrow: 10–13px, weight 600–700, 0.14–0.2em tracking, UPPERCASE, gold-muted or moss green, with a short gold dash/rule.

rules.colorUsage: Primary palette first; greens/yellow/grays second; purple least. Gold (Cosmic Alloy #A18B2F) is the emphasis color.
rules.positioning: Unified liquidity layer / infrastructure — never a coin. Visuals favor conduit/channel over a coin object.
rules.aiAgentsException: The AI Agents pillar always gets a dark, distinct visual treatment vs. the light editorial style of the other three pillars.
rules.imageBackground: Always state background explicitly (e.g. cream #DFDBCB / page #FAFAF8) so image generation does not default to dark.
rules.namingContexts: '$U' in all front-facing marketing copy; 'United Stables' reserved for legal / About contexts.
rules.logoColorways: Gold, Silver, Black, Dark Green, Dark Grey. NEVER recolour outside these.
rules.signatureImagery: Metallic 3D U — half champagne gold, half silver — on silk dunes over a fine grid mesh. Silk-wave banner for social covers / headers.
rules.iconography: No flat icon set — geometric/typographic marks + platform-standard social glyphs (X, Telegram, Instagram; white in ink circles). Substitute Lucide at 1.5–2px stroke for missing UI icons and flag it. Never emoji.
rules.voice: Confident, institutional-fintech, optimistic. Title Case headlines; UPPERCASE eyebrows; short declarative sentences; lists of three; no emoji.
